interface_contracts.name: benchmark
interface_contracts.definition: CLI benchmark subcommand from T13 lazily calls cli.benchmark.main(argv:list[str])->int. Fixed 8 cases with known defects/clean/unilateral, development and held-out sets. Evaluate imported per-mode results for codex-only, claude-only, dual, official-plugin baseline; dedup verified finding matches, missed, false positives, duration and reported usage. Never fabricate real model findings/latency/usage or call models automatically. Oracle/held-out答案只供评分器读取，不放入冻结快照、prompt或审核cwd。四模式同样可见输入哈希，记录prompt模板版本。 T13仅先交付审核入口；本卡顺序扩展main添加benchmark子命令，调用本模块main，避免前置提交暴露尚未实现命令。
